source.package: sherpa-ncnn 2.1.11 aarch64 manylinux wheel (upstream k2-fsa build)

why_2_1_11: k2-fsa publishes no linux-aarch64 binary outside its PyPI wheels: the v2.1.15 GitHub release carries only Android, Windows and wasm assets.
From 2.1.13 onwards the wheel folds the C API into the pybind11 module and stops shipping standalone shared libraries, so it cannot be loaded through ctypes.
2.1.11 is the newest wheel that still ships libsherpa-ncnn-c-api.so, libsherpa-ncnn-core.so, libkaldi-native-fbank-core.so and libncnn.so as separate objects.
SherpaNcnnRecognizerConfig is byte-identical between v2.1.11 and v2.1.15, and both builds export the same unprefixed C entry points, so the ctypes layout used for armv7 works unchanged.
notes: libgomp keeps its auditwheel-mangled filename because libncnn records that exact string in DT_NEEDED. native_libs preloads it with RTLD_GLOBAL so the dynamic linker satisfies the reference without editing system library search paths.
The wheel's own _sherpa_ncnn*.so extension is not shipped: it needs numpy and exposes no C API symbols.
Models are architecture independent; the same resources/models trees serve both user spaces.

This build uses the pre-C++11 std::string ABI. Loading it into Kodi (which links a new-ABI libstdc++ first) interposes the shared weak template symbols and corrupts the heap, killing Kodi. resources/lib/ncnn_worker.py therefore runs the engine in a separate python3 process; see README.
